name: Visual Style Guide
visualIdentity: Established Titan Gates mythological tactical presentation with cel-shaded/game-readable 3D environments and enormous Titans.
presentationRules: Elongated 3D battlefield presentation with tactical readability.
Titans remain visually enormous through scale sheets, shadows, camera, clearance, and gate/structure proportions.
Terrain hazards are physical environment features, not board-game overlays.
Use canonical faction visual identity only.
directors: 3D Asset Director translates canonical assets into 3D production specs without overriding Lore Director.

scale.rule: Global reference anchors all 3D asset scale/material/style contracts.

mobilePerformanceTarget: Global reference for mobile tactical 3D production.

technicalNotes.collisionRequirements: Global reference only; asset packages define collision meshes.
